roster.title: Employee Roster
roster.description: Keep reusable employee records, sites, groups, job specs, and compliance cues ready before you build appointments.

helpers.employees: Search, filter, import, or add employees here. Select multiple employees when you need to apply a site in one action.
helpers.sites: Sites help you book and report by location. Add each recurring workplace once, then assign employees to it.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Create reusable teams, departments, shifts, or crews so bulk booking starts with the right people and default services.

helpers.groups: Choose a group to manage members and default services. A group can be as broad as a department or as specific as a shift.
helpers.members: Members added here can be selected together when building an appointment.

site.title: Site
site.description: Review which roster employees are assigned to this site and add missing people from your roster.

helpers.employees: Removing someone from a site only removes this site assignment; it does not delete the employee from your roster.
helpers.addEmployees: Use this when a site has new employees or when imported roster records still need a location.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Manage the companies you can book for, edit their details, and keep company-specific employee lists tidy.

helpers.create: Use the registered legal details where you have them. Only the company name is required to get started.
helpers.list: Open a company to edit billing details or connect roster employees to that company.

companyDetail.title: Company
companyDetail.description: Update company details and connect roster employees who belong to this company.

helpers.details: These fields update the company record used by ClinicPlus Companion. Save only when the billing or registration details are correct.
helpers.employees: Company membership helps filter the roster during booking. It does not create or remove appointment records.

book.title: Book from roster
book.description: Build an appointment from saved employees, reuse job specs, check clinic capacity, and submit with the required NDA.

helpers.referenceForms: Download supporting ClinicPlus forms here before you submit the booking.
helpers.schedule: Choose the clinic and date first so capacity checks can warn you before the appointment is submitted.
helpers.employees: Add employees from the roster, then expand each person to confirm services, job spec files, Dover, and X-ray requirements.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.description: Find existing appointments, review their status, and open one when you need to edit, duplicate, message, or manage it.

helpers.filters: Use filters together to narrow the list by status, clinic, and date range.
helpers.table: Appointment IDs open the full appointment record, including employees, files, messages, and management actions.

appointmentDetail.title: Appointment
appointmentDetail.description: Review the appointment, check submitted documents and employees, and use the action buttons for changes.

helpers.details: This summary mirrors the submitted booking details. Use edit when the clinic, date, or billing fields need to change.
helpers.employees: Employee rows show the submitted services and files. Removing an employee updates this appointment only.
helpers.managers: Users listed here can manage this appointment record.

appointmentEdit.title: Edit appointment
appointmentEdit.description: Adjust appointment details and manage employees while preserving the appointment record and audit trail.

helpers.details: Changing clinic or date re-checks blocked dates and daily clinic capacity before saving.
helpers.employees: Add employees from the roster. To change an existing employee's details, update the roster entry and re-add them.

availability.title: Availability Calendar
availability.description: Check clinic capacity by month before choosing an appointment date.

helpers.controls: Switch clinics or months to compare capacity before starting a booking.
helpers.legend: Green has plenty of capacity, amber is close to full, and red is already fully booked.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.description: Track medical and service expiry status per employee so repeat bookings are easier to plan.

helpers.filters: Filter by status or company to focus on the employees that need action first.
helpers.table: Draft data means the expiry rule is not confirmed yet; treat those rows as planning signals, not final compliance decisions.

insights.title: Insights
insights.description: Turn appointment history into booking, revenue, lifecycle, service, and company-level patterns.

helpers.gate: Opening insights may use credits because it calculates a richer report from your appointment history.
helpers.exports: Export CSV for spreadsheet analysis or PDF for a quick shareable snapshot.

finances.title: Finances
finances.description: Buy credits, monitor your balance, and review the ledger of purchases and charged actions.

helpers.balance: Credits are consumed by paid workflow actions. Top up before large imports, bulk updates, or report exports.
helpers.transactions: Use the filters to separate purchases from action charges when reconciling your account.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Manage your account details, password, account ID, and deletion request options.

helpers.stats: These totals summarize your current ClinicPlus Companion footprint.
helpers.security: Use a unique password and keep your account email current so support and notifications reach the right person.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Control account-level preferences, product feedback, audit visibility, and high-risk bulk actions.

helpers.spending: This setting changes whether ClinicPlus Companion asks before running priced actions; it never changes the credit cost.
helpers.danger: Bulk deletion actions require explicit confirmation and should be used only when you are clearing real working data.

featureRequest.title: Suggest Feature
featureRequest.description: Send ClinicPlus Companion feature ideas straight to the product team with enough context to evaluate the request.

helpers.form: Describe the workflow or problem first, then explain who it helps or how much time it saves.

serviceValidity.title: Service Validity Periods
serviceValidity.description: Configure how long medical services remain valid before compliance tracking flags them for renewal.

helpers.global: This is global superadmin configuration shared across companies. Draft rows should be confirmed before teams rely on them.
helpers.form: Add or update one service at a time. A service with no row is ignored by expiry tracking.

forbidden.title: Forbidden
forbidden.description: This page is restricted to superadmins.
